title: Come Home
description: A mod that teleports you home.
body:
# Void Compass

The **Void Compass** is a powerful item designed to make exploration and travel simple and reliable. With it, you can set a personal "home" location and teleport back to it instantly, even across dimensions. 

## Features

- **Set Your Home:** Right-click any block to mark it as your home location. The compass remembers both the position and the dimension.  
- **Teleport Home:** Right-click the air to instantly teleport back to your saved home spot. Perfect for returning from dangerous locations or long journeys.  
- **Durability Affects Usage:** Each teleport uses a bit of durability. When the compass breaks, it transforms into a **Broken Void Compass**, making it clear it can no longer teleport you.  
- **Simple and Intuitive:** No complicated setup, menus, or crafting requirements. Pick a home, and teleport whenever you need to return.

## How to get:
There's something in **The End**, check it out. _Also_, look at birch forests, you might find something there.
